decisions.reason: The landing-page application of the shared breakpoint guidance is already fully represented by its existing message-27 MODIFY, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The responsive-guidance decision does not change the candidate's page-theme, shared-chrome, or visual-foundation attributes.
The cross-page breakpoint guidance concerns website pages and does not alter the separately built console shell's styling scope or design attributes.
Applying shared breakpoint guidance does not change the selected plain-HTML, Tailwind CSS, or no-Astro implementation stack.
The responsive-guidance decision does not change the footer's requirement to be shared across webpages or establish any footer-specific responsive attribute.
Breakpoint guidance does not alter the landing page's theme, typography, colors, concept preferences, or other visual-system attributes.
The cross-page responsive rule does not change whether the previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The responsive-guidance decision does not change the section's position, sequential presentation, or listed steps.
The shared breakpoint guidance does not change the sign-up action or its button control.
